Support & safety

Get help with the app, report abuse, or find the right place to manage your account.

bobmaster@hibobmaster.com

BobMaster handles app feedback. Include your OS, app version, server, and steps to reproduce. Keep passwords, access tokens, and private messages out of your email.

Report, block, and filter

Open a post’s or profile’s menu and choose Report. The report goes to moderators on your Mastodon server. Use Block on a profile to prevent unwanted contact, or mute an account to hide its posts. In Settings → Filters, add words or phrases to hide or warn about matching content.

Abuse, harassment, illegal content, and non-consensual intimate material have no place in QuanToot. Follow your server’s rules when posting. If your server’s reporting path is unavailable, or content continues to be surfaced in QuanToot after you report it, contact BobMaster with public post links and the relevant server. The developer can investigate app-level issues. The server’s moderators control content on that service.

Delete or remove an account

For permanent deletion, sign in with the account you want to delete, then open Settings → Delete Mastodon account. Continue to your own server’s deletion page and confirm there. If your server uses a different route, open its web preferences, select Account, and find Delete account or contact the operator. Mastodon account documentation.

To remove the sign-in from this device, open Accounts and use Remove account. To clear cached media, use Settings → Clear media cache.

Common questions

Which server should I enter?

Use the domain after the final @ in your Mastodon handle. If you are browsing as a guest, a server may require sign-in before showing some public timelines.

Where can I get the app?

Download the official Android packages. iPhone and iPad availability will be announced here after App Store approval.

举报、屏蔽与过滤

打开帖子或个人资料的菜单，选择举报，举报会发送给你所在实例的管理员。你也可在个人资料菜单里屏蔽或静音账号，或在设置 → 过滤器中管理关键词。

请遵守所在实例的发帖规则。QuanToot 不欢迎骚扰、仇恨、违法内容及未经同意传播的私密影像。如果实例无法受理，或举报后的内容仍在 QuanToot 里异常显示，请联系 BobMaster，附上公开帖文链接及实例名称。开发者可以排查应用端问题，服务器上的内容由该实例管理员处理。

删除或移除账号

要永久删除账号，请登录对应账号，打开设置 → 删除 Mastodon 账号，进入所属实例的删除页面，并在实例上确认。如果实例使用不同路径，请从实例的网页偏好设置进入账号，找到删除入口或联系实例管理员。Mastodon 账号文档。

如只需移除此设备上的登录，打开账号页面并选择移除账号。可在设置 → 清除媒体缓存清理已缓存的媒体。

常见问题

应该填写哪个实例？

填入 Mastodon 账号最后一个 @ 后面的域名。以访客身份浏览时，部分实例可能要求先登录才能读取公开时间线。

在哪里下载？

下载正式 Android 安装包。iPhone 和 iPad 版通过 App Store 审核后会在这里公布。
